# Partner escalation digest - FIU adapter interop issues

Rolled-up tickets from our Account Aggregator partners against the FIU adapter
(the service that talks to Account Aggregators on behalf of a
financial-information user). The build is clean and the shipped checks pass, so
none of this is caught before deploy. Both reporters emphasise the same
pattern: ordinary traffic is fine, and the failures key off the *content* of
specific values rather than load, timing, or sequence.

---

**AA partner (ticket #4471):**
> Your adapter is rejecting a subset of our callbacks as `invalid` on the
> transaction / consent identifier, and the rejected ids are well-formed UUIDs -
> canonical form, straight from our generator. Most UUIDs go through. We diffed
> accepted vs rejected ids and cannot see what distinguishes them; whatever
> validity check you run is *almost* right, and genuinely malformed ids are
> still (correctly) refused.

**AA partner (ticket #4488):**
> Separately: your outgoing notification timestamps are wrong in the afternoon.
> An event we both logged at 13:47 UTC arrives stamped 01:47 on the same date.
> Date, minutes, seconds all agree; mornings are fine. Our parser now rejects
> some of your afternoon messages outright.

---

**Triage note (ops):** these two are the ones partners have pinned down, but
our own sweep says they are not isolated. A few more of the adapter's small,
deterministic helpers in the same family - identifier and payload handling,
field validation - drift in exactly the same way: correct on the ordinary
values the system produces for itself, wrong by a hair on one specific edge
form that routine traffic never feeds them. Away from those edges everything
behaves, which is why the shipped checks never surface any of it.

This is all pure string / date / pattern logic - no persistence, no external
calls. Restore correct behaviour on these content-dependent edge inputs without
changing anything on the paths that already behave; the project's checks pass
now and must stay passing.

Do not add or modify anything under `src/test/`.

Verify the build with:

    cd /app && mvn -o -q -pl webservice test
I'll investigate the FIU adapter's identifier and timestamp helpers for the content-dependent edge-case bugs partners reported.

# FIU Adapter: Identifier/Timestamp Helper Findings

## Project structure (webservice-relevant)

Multi-module Maven FIU adapter (`com.enterprise:fiu-adapter`):

| Module | Role |
|--------|------|
| `/app/webservice` | Main Spring Boot app (controllers, validation, AA/FIU flows) |
| `/app/jws-signature` | JWS sign/verify |
| `/app/diffie-hellman-services` | ECC/DH crypto |
| `/app/kms` | Key management |

Webservice layout under  
`/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/`:

```
utils/           ← pure helpers (UUID, timestamp, null checks, dates)
constants/       ← GeneralConstants (UUID regex), Status, SessionStatus, FIStatus
service/
  consentnotification/  ← ConsentNotificationValidationImpl
  finotification/       ← FIDataNotificationValidationImpl
  consentinit/          ← validateCustomerId, consent date ranges
  consent/, firequest/, fetchfidata/, aarestapi/, ...
controller/      consent, fidata, aaclient, authentication, ...
representation/  request/response DTOs (+ @Pattern on Customer)
security/        SignatureVerificationFilter, JWT filters
exceptions/      GlobalException (formats error timestamps)
```

No `src/test` tree under webservice.

---

## Key files and roles

| Absolute path | Role |
|---------------|------|
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/UUIDGenerator.java` | Generate UUID; `regaxUUIDvalidation` |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/GeneralConstants.java` | `VALID_PATTERN_UUID` and error strings |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/TimeStampValidation.java` | Parse + age/future checks on inbound timestamps |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/DateTimeUtil.java` | Format outbound ISO timestamps; add days/months |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/NullEmptyUtils.java` | Null/empty helpers (incl. treating `0` as empty for numbers) |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/GetDetachedBody.java` | JWS detached payload segment via `split(".")[2]` |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/Base64Decoder.java` | Base64 → JSON object |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/consentnotification/ConsentNotificationValidationImpl.java` | Consent notify: UUID/timestamp/status/schematic checks |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/finotification/FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.java` | FI notify: UUID/timestamp/session/FI status checks |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/consentinit/ConsentInitServiceImpl.java` | `validateCustomerId`; consent start/expiry/FIDataRange via `DateTimeUtil` |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/representation/request/Customer.java` | Bean Validation customer VUA pattern |

---

## Patterns / formats

### UUID regex (buggy)

```43:43:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/GeneralConstants.java
    public static final String VALID_PATTERN_UUID = "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{11}$";
```

Used by:

```20:22:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/UUIDGenerator.java
    public static boolean regaxUUIDvalidation(String uuid){
        return Pattern.matches(GeneralConstants.VALID_PATTERN_UUID, uuid);
    }
```

Call sites:
- Consent notify: `txnid`, `consentHandle`, `consentId` (unless REJECTED) — `ConsentNotificationValidationImpl` L51–66  
- FI notify: `txnid`, `sessionId` — `FIDataNotificationValidationImpl` L67–76  

**Issues:**
1. **Last group `{11}` should be `{12}`** — standard UUID node is 12 hex digits. Valid UUIDs like `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` **fail** validation. Self-generated `UUID.randomUUID().toString()` also has 12-char last group, so generated IDs would fail this regex if re-validated.
2. **Lowercase only** (`[0-9a-f]`) — uppercase UUIDs rejected.
3. **Version-4 only** (literal `4` in group 3) and RFC variant `[89ab]` only.
4. Method name typo: `regaxUUIDvalidation`.

### Timestamp parse pattern (buggy)

```23:23:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/TimeStampValidation.java
            SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'");
```

**Issues:**
1. **`yyyyy` (5 y’s)** — should be `yyyy`. Year pattern is wrong for ISO-8601.
2. **`'Z'` is a literal Z**, not timezone — offsets like `+05:30` / `Z` as zone designator are not handled as real TZ.
3. **Requires milliseconds** (`.SSS`) — timestamps without fractional seconds fail.
4. **No `setLenient(false)`** — lenient `SimpleDateFormat` accepts impossible calendar values.
5. **Not thread-safe** — new instance per call mitigates this somewhat.
6. Future check uses `new Date().before(date)` (wall clock) while age window uses `System.currentTimeMillis()` — minor inconsistency; clock skew edge cases possible.

### Timestamp format pattern (buggy)

```46:50:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/DateTimeUtil.java
    public static String getISOTimeStamp( Long milliSecond )
    {
        DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormat.forPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh:mm:ss.SSS'Z'");
        DateTime currentDate = new DateTime(milliSecond, DateTimeZone.UTC);
        return currentDate.toString(formatter);
```

**Issues:**
1. **`hh` = 12-hour clock** — should be `HH` for 24-hour UTC. Hours 00 and 13–23 format incorrectly (e.g. 15:30 UTC → `03:30:…Z`).
2. Outbound timestamps from this helper may then **fail inbound** `TimeStampValidation` or look “in the past/future” incorrectly.
3. Used widely for notifications/errors/consent payloads (`ConsentServiceImpl`, `CallBackServiceImpl`, `FIDataNotificationValidationImpl`, `GlobalException`, filters, etc.).

### `getAddedDate` timezone mix

```26:33:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/DateTimeUtil.java
    public static String getAddedDate( Long currentMilliSecond, int days, int month )
    {
        DateTime date = new DateTime(currentMilliSecond, DateTimeZone.UTC);
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance();  // JVM default TZ
        c.setTime(date.toDate());
        c.add(Calendar.DATE, days);
        c.add(Calendar.MONTH, month);
        return getISOTimeStamp(new DateTime(c.getTimeInMillis(), DateTimeZone.UTC).getMillis());
```

UTC `DateTime` → default-TZ `Calendar` add → format as UTC. Near DST/offset boundaries, day/month math can shift.

### Customer ID pattern

```24:24:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/representation/request/Customer.java
    @Pattern( regexp = "^[01-9a-zA-Z]+@[a-zA-Z]+[-][a-zA-Z]+", message = "Invalid Customer Identifier" )
```

**Notes:**
- `01-9` is effectively digits 0–9 (odd spelling of `0-9`).
- Requires exactly one `-` in AA handle (`aa-handle` style).
- No `$` end anchor; Bean Validation `@Pattern` still full-matches via `Matcher.matches()`.
- No digits in AA handle portion.

### `validateCustomerId` logic (suspicious)

```89:111:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/consentinit/ConsentInitServiceImpl.java
    public String validateCustomerId( String customerId ) throws DataException
    {
        ...
                if(customerIdSplit.size() > 1) {
                    return "@" + customerId.trim().split("@")[0].trim();
```

Comment says “return the AA ID”, but it returns **`"@" + local-part`** (e.g. `user@aa-finvu` → `@user`), not the handle after `@`. Likely inverted split index / wrong return value.

---

## Other suspicious deterministic helpers

### Schematic error single-field check (broken)

Both validation impls:

```39:40:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/consentnotification/ConsentNotificationValidationImpl.java
        if(errorMsg.split(",").length == 1 && errorMsg != ""){
```

```56:57:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/finotification/FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.java
        if(errorMessage.split(",").length == 1 && errorMessage !=""){
```

Empty fields build `"key,"`. `"key,".split(",")` → `["key", ""]` **length 2**, so the “exactly one field” branch almost never runs; multi-field message path always used instead. Also `errorMsg != ""` should be `!errorMsg.isEmpty()` / `!equals` (reference compare is accidental but works for interned `""` from concat).

### Nested field NPE in schematic checks

`schematicErrorCheck` puts parent objects then immediately reads nested getters (`getConsentStatusNotification().getConsentHandle()`, etc.). If parent is null, **NPE before** map null aggregation.

### Session status uses `contains` not `equals`

```93:96:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/finotification/FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.java
            for (SessionStatus c : SessionStatus.values()) {
                if (c.name().contains(fiNotificationRequest.getFIStatusNotification().getSessionStatus())) {
```

Same in `checkSessionStatus` L209–212. Partial strings can match (e.g. empty string matches every enum name via `contains("")`).

### Consent status uses exact `equals` (inconsistent with session)

`ConsentNotificationValidationImpl` L71–74 uses `c.name().equals(...)` — correct; FI path does not.

### `NullEmptyUtils.isNullorEmpty(Number)`

```28:30:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/NullEmptyUtils.java
    public static boolean isNullorEmpty( Number val )
    {
        return isNull(val) || val.doubleValue() == 0.0D || val.intValue() == 0;
```

Treats legitimate `0` as empty (relevant if dataLife/value fields go through this).

### `GetDetachedBody`

```17:20:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/GetDetachedBody.java
    public static String getDetached( String body )
    {
        return body.split("\\.")[2];
```

No length/null checks — short/malformed JWS → `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`.

### FI notify UUID failure replaces txnId

```67:68:/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/enterprise/fiuadapter/webservice/service/finotification/FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.java
        if(!UUIDGenerator.regaxUUIDvalidation(fiNotificationRequest.getTxnid())){
            throw new InvalidRequestException(UUIDGenerator.generateUUID(),...
```

On bad `txnid`, error response gets a **new** UUID instead of the request’s txnid (consent path keeps original). Harder to correlate.

---

## Highest-priority pure-logic bug candidates

| Severity | Location | Bug |
|----------|----------|-----|
| **Critical** | `GeneralConstants` L43 | UUID last segment `{11}` → rejects all standard 36-char UUIDs |
| **Critical** | `DateTimeUtil` L48 | `hh` vs `HH` → wrong hours on all outbound ISO timestamps |
| **High** | `TimeStampValidation` L23 | `yyyyy` typo; rigid `.SSS'Z'`; lenient parse |
| **High** | `ConsentInitServiceImpl` L97 | Customer/AA ID extraction returns wrong segment |
| **Medium** | `DateTimeUtil.getAddedDate` | Default-TZ `Calendar` vs UTC |
| **Medium** | FI session status validation | `contains` instead of `equals` |
| **Medium** | Schematic `split(",").length == 1` | Single-field error path broken |
| **Low** | UUID regex case / version lock-in | Uppercase & non-v4 rejected |
| **Low** | `GetDetachedBody` | Unchecked split index |
| **Low** | `NullEmptyUtils` Number | `0` ≡ empty |

---

## Where validation is applied (flow sketch)

1. **Consent notification (AA → adapter):**  
   `ConsentNotificationValidationImpl.validateRequestFields` → schematic → version → UUID(txn/handle/id) → `TimeStampValidation` → status enum → notifier AA → entity lookup.

2. **FI notification (AA → adapter):**  
   `FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.validateRequestFields` → same pattern for txn/session + session/FI status enums.

3. **Outbound to FIU / AA:**  
   Timestamps almost always via `DateTimeUtil.getISOTimeStamp(...)` (and thus the `hh` bug).

4. **AA response timestamp checks** also call `TimeStampValidation` from `ConsentServiceImpl`, `AaRestApiServiceImpl`, `FiRequestServiceImpl`, `FiDataServiceImpl`, `ConsentArtifactServiceImpl`.

These pure helpers in `utils/` + `GeneralConstants.VALID_PATTERN_UUID` are the best places for deterministic edge-case tests; the UUID length and hour-format bugs are the most likely production footguns.
</task_result>
</task>
